        org     25000
        ld      hl,#5CF4
        ld      (hl),#7
        inc     hl
        ld      (hl),#11
        ld      hl,26000
        ld      (START),hl
        ld      a,27
        ld      (LEN),a
        ld      a,(#5D16)
        res     4,a
        ld      (DRIVE+1),a
        jr      STRT

PRINT   equ     16384
START   dw      0
LEN     db      0
NAD1    db      0
NAD2    db      0
NAD3    db      0
NAD4    db      10
BACK    db      255

STRT    ei
        halt
        sub     a
        ld      c,a
        ld      d,a
        ld      e,a
        ld      a,(LEN)
        ld      b,3
L1      sub     100
        jr      c,DES
        inc     c
        djnz    L1
DES     add     a,100
        ld      b,10
L2      sub     10
        jr      c,ED
        inc     e
        djnz    L2
ED      add     a,10
        or      a
        jr      z,END
        inc     d
        ld      b,10
L3      dec     a
        jr      z,END
        inc     d
        djnz    L3
END     ld      ix,NAD1
        ld      a,c
        ld      (NAD1),a
        ld      (NAD2),de
        ld      de,PRINT
LOOP    ld      a,(ix)
        ld      l,a
        cp      255
        jr      z,VER
        push    de
        sub     a
        ld      h,a
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        add     hl,hl
        ld      bc,NUMB
        add     hl,bc
        ld      b,8
LOOP1   ld      a,(hl)
        ld      (de),a
        inc     d
        inc     hl
        djnz    LOOP1
        pop     de
        inc     e
        inc     ix
        jr      LOOP
VER     ld      a,(NAD4)
        cp      10
        jr      nz,YUI
        ld      a,11
BBC     ld      (NAD4),a
        jr      LOA
YUI     ld      a,10
        jr      BBC
LOA     ld      a,(LEN)
        or      a
        jp      z,L_OK
        di
        sub     a
        inc     a
        ld      b,a
        ld      hl,(START)
        ld      de,(#5CF4)
M1      push    bc
        ld      c,d
        srl     c
DRIVE   ld      a,#2C
        jr      c,M2
        add     a,#10
M2      ld      ix,#1FF3
        call    DOS
        ld      a,c
        ld      c,#7F
        ld      ix,#2A53
        call    DOS
        ld      a,#18
        ld      ix,#2FC3
        call    DOS
        pop     bc
M3      push    de,bc
        ld      ix,#2F1B
        call    DOS
        pop     bc,de
        inc     e
        inc     h
        bit     4,e
        jr      nz,M4
        djnz    M3
        jr      LOE
M4      inc     d
        ld      e,0
        djnz    M1
LOE     ld      (#5CF4),de
        ld      a,(LEN)
        dec     a
        ld      (LEN),a
        ld      hl,(START)
        ld      de,256
        add     hl,de
        ld      (START),hl
        jp      STRT
NUMB    db 0,0,254,206,214,230,254,0,0,0,248,56,56,56,254,0,0,0
        db 254,6,254,224,254,0,0,0,254,6,254,6,254,0,0,0,230,230
        db 254,6,6,0,0,0,254,224,254,6,254,0,224,224,224,224,254
        db 230,254,0,0,0,254,6,6,6,6,6,0,0,254,230,254,230,254,0
        db 0,0,254,230,254,6,6,6,0,0,0,0,0,0,255,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
        db 0
FONE    db #30,0,1,0,#50,0,0,#38,#10,#10,#10,#C4,#50,1,#C8
PAUSE   ld      b,15
PA_1    ei
        halt
        djnz    PA_1
        ret
DOS     push    ix
        jp      #3D2F
L_OK    ld      hl,FONE
        sub     a
ZW3     ld      bc,#FFFD
        out     (c),a
        push    af
        ld      a,(hl)
        ld      bc,#BFFD
        out     (c),a
        inc     hl
        pop     af
        inc     a
        cp      #F
        jr      nz,ZW3
        ld      b,5
L_OB    push    bc
        ld      hl,PRINT+3+(256*6)
        ld      (hl),255
        call    PAUSE
        ld      (hl),0
        call    PAUSE
        pop     bc
        djnz    L_OB
        ei
        ret
